Class 8A playoff preview: Oswego East in Opening Round
Oswego East meets Curie in a Class 8A Opening Round game this weekend, and according to our projections, Oswego East will win 27-21.
Oswego East meets Curie in a Class 8A Opening Round game this weekend, and according to our projections, Oswego East will win 27-21.
The top 16 seeds in the 48-team Class 8A field have byes in the Opening Round, and the other 32 teams play Friday and Saturday, Oct. 23-24.
Winners advance to the First Round on Saturday, Oct. 31.
We call a game competitive if our projection has it decided by 10 points or fewer and a blowout if the margin is 21 points or more.
Oswego, the No. 4 seed in the statewide field, has a bye and plays the winner of No. 29 Naperville Central and No. 36 Warren in the First Round.
Opening Round schedule and predictions
Saturday, Oct. 24
- noon: No. 34 Oswego East (4-5) vs. No. 31 Curie (5-4) at Rockne Stadium (Oswego East 27, Curie 21)
Game Capsules
No. 34 Oswego East (4-5) vs. No. 31 Curie (5-4)
Oswego East and Curie meet at Rockne Stadium in the Class 8A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 2 Huntley (9-0) in the First Round.
Kickoff is noon Saturday.
#34 Oswego East (4-5)
Oswego East (4-5) is the No. 34 seed in the 48-team Class 8A field and meets No. 31 Curie in the Opening Round. It qualified with a losing record.
Oswego East went 4-5 overall and 0-5 in Southwest Prairie (West), scoring 175 points and allowing 154, an average margin of +2.3 a game.
Oswego East went 6-4 last season, including 0-1 in playoffs. Oswego East has reached the playoffs in seven of the last 10 seasons.
